target_customer: Claims and SIU organizations at P&C carriers, MGAs and TPAs
problem: Insurers can only investigate a small share of claims, so fraud and errors slip through. Hesper agents investigate each claim end to end and produce an audit-ready file.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to insurance claims teams (pricing not disclosed)
product_category: AI claims investigation for property and casualty insurance

founders.name: Pankaj Dhariwal
education: Dual degree in Electronics and Economics, BITS Pilani
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built Nanonets Flow accounts payable product to $200K ARR.

founders.name: Nitish Badu
education: Degree from BITS Pilani, field not stated
founders.background_notes: YC page says he scaled Nanonets revenue to $4M ARR.

competitors.name: Shift Technology
competitors.what: Insurance fraud and claims AI with investigation planning and autonomous investigation features
competitors.traction_then: Established vendor with a 2026 product refresh

competitors.name: Carpe Claims
competitors.what: Unified agentic claims suite with three new AI products

technical_complexity.rationale: Document tamper detection, fact verification and integration with Guidewire and Duck Creek need solid engineering, but build on foundation models available in 2026.

defensibility.rationale: Core system integrations and carrier trust help, but many AI claims entrants launched in 2025 and 2026, and incumbents hold years of claims data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Unknown so far; Shift already advertised autonomous investigation features in 2026.

market_need_then: A 2026 trade article says automated tools now make 45% of SIU referrals while SIU staffing grew about 0.5% in 2024, per the Coalition Against Insurance Fraud. That implies investigator capacity is the bottleneck.

branding.domain_note: Uses gethesperai.com, a prefixed domain rather than the exact name.

identity.visual_style: Product-as-UI mock status boards with uppercase labels

branding.brand_signature: Every Claim Investigated, Not Just Processed

brand_strength.rationale: Early and B2B; no press about the brand found. Confusable with Harper (AI insurance brokerage) and Esper in search results.

outcome_analysis: Hesper is an active Fall 2026 YC company of three people with no public traction figures yet. Founders have Nanonets sales and engineering experience in document AI, which fits the product. The key risk is a crowded 2026 AI claims market where incumbents already ship agentic investigation.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: Dealroom $125K; CB Insights $500K convertible note, founded 2024, San Francisco. Both aggregators, so no round recorded. Company site says backed by Y Combinator and Afore Capital but gives no amounts, and a search did not confirm Afore. YC page lists 3 team members in data but only two founders named. No shutdown or acquisition found. Both entries rest on a single database each (CB Insights 500K convertible note; Dealroom 125K) with no dates, and they conflict, so they may be the same financing and are not additive. A further search found no press and no support for Afore Capital.
